description: Power System Transient Stability Assessment Simulations Dataset - IEEE New England 39-bus test case is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Petar Sarajcev, Antonijo Kunac (University of Split, FESB). This dataset contains phasor measurements (PMU-type) signals from the IEEE New England 39-bus power system test case network, which are generated from a large corpus of systematic MATLAB®/Simulink electro-mechanical transients simulations. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
